entities.summary: Armen Agop is an Egyptian artist. His work includes sculpture and other forms of visual art. Agop’s artistic practice incorporates meditative processes and themes related to contemplation and material form. His work has been associated with minimalist approaches that emphasize simplicity, restraint, and slow, deliberate production methods. Armen Agop was a painters & sculptors from Cairo (b. 1969, Cairo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
